data.content: # Devils take on the Flyers in Metropolitan Division matchup. Published Oct. 1, 2026 4:10 a.m. ET. Newark, New Jersey; Thursday, 7 p.m. EDT. LINE: Devils -168, Flyers +137; over/under is 5.5. BOTTOM LINE: The New Jersey Devils host the Philadelphia Flyers in a matchup of Metropolitan Division teams. New Jersey went 7-17-2 in Metropolitan Division games and had a 42-37-3 record overall last season. The Devils committed 254 total penalties last season, averaging 3.1 per game and serving 7.5 penalty minutes per game. Philadelphia went 43-27-12 overall and 16-13-7 in division games a season ago. The Flyers scored 240 total goals last season (37 power-play goals and seven shorthanded goals). INJURIES: Devils: Nick Bjugstad: out (pectoral), Johnathan Kovacevic: out (knee), Arseny Gritsyuk: out for season (upper-body), Seamus Casey: out (knee), Connor Brown: out (lower-body).
